"You mean Kawahara, don't you?"
"Don't go thinking it was fate.
You chose to come here yourself."
"...Was that really all right for him?"
"That's for Kawahara to decide."
"What... what should I do from now on?"
"Decide that yourself."
"All right.
I'll join the newspaper club.
That's my answer."
"That isn't an answer.
There are no answers.
You were thinking that yourself during the exam, weren't you?"
"Was I thinking something like that?"
"Want me to do an impression?"
"Please."{p}
